from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its assigned cause category."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    cause_category: str | None = Field(description="The cause category identified in the document text, to be matched against the task's list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CaseDocument]
